title: Kronecker Products, Polarity Quotients and Large Graph Constructions
summary: In this paper, we establish a structural compatibility between the Kronecker product of bipartite graphs that admit polarity and their polarity quotients, and provide a sharp upper bound on the diameter of these graphs. We use these properties to construct new families of graphs, all of which have orders that asymptotically approach the Moore bound.
